purpose: Untouched forward confirmation test, not further historical optimization.

model.training_rule: Expanding training window. For a signal on date T, train only on rows whose 5-trading-day future_return label is observable from data available at T.
model.missing_data: Rows with missing full 62-feature research matrix values or missing target are excluded before the frozen 18 selected features are used. This preserves the exact historical warmup/eligibility rule used when the specification was frozen.

signal.execution_convention: Signal generated after daily close; intended execution next session.

data_sources.feed: Alpaca IEX daily bars used in current research files

regime_filter.name: SOXX 200-day moving average filter
regime_filter.rule: Exposure is 1.0 if SOXX close is above its trailing 200-day simple moving average, else 0.0.

portfolio.weighting: Risk-adjusted predicted score within selected top names; final weights multiplied by regime exposure.
portfolio.rebalance_schedule: Every 5 trading days in backtest; forward signal generation should be archived on scheduled rebalance dates.
portfolio.transaction_cost_formula: cost = turnover * transaction_cost_bps / 10000; turnover convention is two-way absolute weight change.

benchmarks: Equal-weight semiconductors with same SOXX 200d filter
60-day momentum selection with same SOXX 200d filter

pass_fail_criteria.minimum_confirmation_period: Do not judge from a few weeks; collect an untouched sequence first.
pass_directional: active return vs filtered equal-weight semis > 0
turnover and implementation shortfall close to assumptions
failure_warning: performance depends on one stock or one month
filter-off behavior or filter-on behavior contradicts documented assumptions

research_selection_bias_note: The historical period was used to choose this specification. It cannot independently prove the strategy. Forward data after the freeze date is the confirmation test.
